newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian silver up on industry demand as gold slides.
newsitem.headline: Indian silver up on industry demand as gold slides.

text.p: Indian silver opened lower on the back of a weak trend in the world market but renewed industrial enquiries trimmed early losses towards the close, dealers said.
"Restricted arrivals also helped market to bounce back from the lower level," one dealer said.
Silver was down 35 rupees per kg on Wednesday. Gold opened higher on scattered seasonal enquiries but slid towards the close amid in activity. Gold was down by 5 rupees per 10 gramme on Wednesday.
